results.claim: No coefficient-blind rectangular partition with K<n/(2L+3) controls every original-range coefficient in a fixed bounded-moment class

results.parameters: D>=3,c>0,gamma>=1; lambdaL=4D*sin(pi/(2(L+1)))^2<c; m=2*(L^D+D*L^(D-1)); M0=m*gamma^(D/2)+1; mu=gamma*n^2; n sufficiently large
results.range_mean_moment: f=m/n^D<=1/2; a=1 on S, A=(mu-f)/(1-f) otherwise; mu<=A<=2mu; mean a=mu; moment<=M0; targetmaximum1
results.quantifiers: For every small coefficient-blind partition there exists an adversarial coefficient and a scalar zero-block-mean witness
results.not: One fixed coefficient defeating every adapted partition; no divergence-zero claim
